{{Quote|Never fight when you can bluff.<br />Never bluff when you can run.<br />Never run when you can sneak.<br />If no one knows you're there, you win.|The Combat Litany of the Smuggler's Creed|<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>}}
The '''Smuggler's Creed''' was a collection of philosophy adhered to by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. Among the contents of the Smuggler's Creed was the '''Combat Litany'''.

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was said to have tried at least in spirit to adhere to these principles.<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor" />
